item.title: Get ready for XREAL AURA at Android Dev Summit 2026.
item.dc:creator: XREAL_Global
item.content:encoded:
Get ready for XREAL AURA at Android Dev Summit 2026.
To ask about something, you first have to describe it.
You stop what you're doing. You look down. You find words for a thing sitting right in front of you, or you photograph it. But what if looking at it wasn’t enough?
Get help with Google Gemini. Gemini works alongside you in any app and can answer questions about what you're seeing and doing, just ask.
And when a question is easier to point at than to phrase, circle it. Circle to search anything you see to satisfy your curiosity, whether it's displayed digitally or in the real world around you.
Hands free. Head up. Nothing interrupted.
Help, right in your view. 🕶 #XREAL #AURA #AndroidXR #GoogleGemini #XRGlasses
Check responses. Compatibility, availability, and age restrictions vary. Some features require setup or subscription. Google, Android, Android XR and Gemini are trademarks of Google LLC.

item.title: "It's a human who has to put on the headset and see if your interaction is natural or not."
item.dc:creator: MetaVRDevs
item.content:encoded:
"It's a human who has to put on the headset and see if your interaction is natural or not."
That's @AshrayPai answering a question about agentic tools from Meta developer advocate @Dilmerv in episode 1 of Unscripted, our new series where a developer and a Meta developer advocate candidly take turns answering questions about building on Meta platforms.
In this episode, Ashray and Dilmer shared how they use agentic tools to accelerate VR development. Scaffolding, SDK and package setup, debugging and test runs all go to Ashray's agents. Comfort and interaction quality stay with him, in the headset. He sums it up as anything that needs testing can go to an agent, and anything that requires judging needs a human.
Watch episode 1 to hear how both of them use agentic tools in their day-to-day workflows and stay tuned for more episodes 👉 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZK0-t56JggU #MetaVR #MetaVRGlasses #DevTools #AICoding https://x.com/MetaVRDevs/status/2112667703203021055/video/1
